The '''Ishori''', a [[Species/Legends|species]] indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isht]], were long-time rivals of the [[Diamal]]a. Their disputes over commerce and resource-sharing were a common source of tension in their part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Ishori refused to allow armed Diamalan vessels into their ports. An attempt by the [[Iphigini]] to resolve the dispute (with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as mediators) was unsuccessful.

Their dispute with the Diamala soon became a flashpoint in a larger dispute in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] over the [[Caamas Document]]. While the Diamala took a "forgive and forget" approach, Ishori Senator [[Ghic Dx'ono]] was one of the leading voices in favor of making the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] pay for their complicity in the destruction of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. The apparent return of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] at the same time did not concern the leadership of the [[Ishori Confederene]], many of whom suspected it to be some sort of Bothan plot. Despite their anti-Bothan stance, the Ishori fleet participated in the [[Battle of Bothawui (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Bothawui]] against three [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]], as fleeing from an enemy that the Diamala stayed to fight would have been too great an embarrassment.

Psychologically, Ishori had what some called a "fight or think" response. They found it difficult to discuss any complicated issue without becoming emotional and agitated. Ishori had horn-tipped fists.
